summary: Completed full testing of Timeline Intelligence Micro-Agent (Stage 3). All 15 features verified working correctly. POST /api/intelligence/timeline/{program_id} returns deterministic 'Unknown' results for both FGCU (D1) and Tampa (D2) since no commit_timing_signals exist in the database. No hallucination detected - division/conference do NOT influence timeline_label.
